source.author: verg
source.text: Namque manus inter maestorumque ora parentum ecce levis summo de vertice visus Iuli fundere lumen apex, tactuque innoxia mollis lambere flamma comas et circum tempora pasci.
source.text_original: Namque manus inter maestorumque ora parentum / ecce levis summo de vertice visus Iuli / fundere lumen apex, tactuque innoxia mollis / lambere flamma comas et circum tempora pasci.
source.text_english: For, amid the hands and the sorrowful faces of his parents, behold, on the top of Iulus’ head a light, gentle flame was seen to pour forth a brightness, and to lick the hair harmlessly with its touch, and to feed around his temples.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: dixit et ingenti flammantem nubila sulco direxit per inane facem, quae puppe propinqua in bifidum discessit iter fratresque petivit Tyndareos, placida et mediis in frontibus haesit protinus amborum lumenque innoxia fundit purpureum, miseris olim implorabile nautis.
reuse.text_original: ' / dixit et ingenti flammantem nubila sulco / direxit per inane facem, quae puppe propinqua / in bifidum discessit iter fratresque petivit / Tyndareos, placida et mediis in frontibus haesit / protinus amborum lumenque innoxia fundit / purpureum, miseris olim implorabile nautis.
reuse.text_english: He spoke, and with a mighty furrow he sent through the void a blazing torch that, as it drew near the ship, parted into a twofold course and sought the sons of Tyndareus; peaceful, it at once clung to the middle of both their brows and pours forth a harmless purple light, once a thing to be implored by wretched sailors.
